resources.string: Allow usage access
Daycompass uses Android\'s usage access to see which app is open and for how long, and sends that to %1$s. Nothing is collected until you allow it.
What goes to your server
The package name of each app you use, like org.mozilla.firefox
When you opened it and for how long
What Daycompass never collects
What you do inside apps: messages, websites, photos or your location
Anything from before you paired this device
Open settings
Find Daycompass in the list, turn on usage access, then come back here.
